purpose: Continue the completed baseline learning run by concentrating new simulations in the primary 46-member NROY region, while measuring whether target-relative discrepancy rules find a usable tighter set.
limitations: This plan must be launched with --continue-from pointing to the completed hm_baseline_learning_20260915 run; it is not a standalone wave-1 plan.
The continuation region is the axis-aligned bounding box of the parent primary NROY set, thinned by proximity to that set. It is a conservative superset approximation because no emulator is used.
The parent NROY region was defined by the illustrative output-variance discrepancy rule. Target-relative results remain sensitivity analyses and do not determine continuation.
The selected 1975 calibration space retains its diagnostic seed bounds; the wider union bounds recommended by B-1/B-2 remain deferred.
No output from this run may be called a posterior, credible interval, or final calibration ensemble.

rationale.max_waves: Run one new focused wave (wave 2) from the verified parent NROY set.
rationale.min_volume_shrinkage: Retained for loop compatibility; only one new wave is scheduled.
rationale.min_nroy_members: Fewer than 10 primary survivors is too sparse for automatic continuation and must be reviewed.

discrepancy.rationale: Maintains the parent's primary learning rule so wave-to-wave contraction can be diagnosed; this remains an illustrative rather than final scientific choice.

sensitivity_discrepancies.label: target_relative_10pct
sensitivity_discrepancies.rationale: A one-sigma model-discrepancy allowance equal to 10% of each observed target; diagnostic only.

sensitivity_discrepancies.label: target_relative_20pct
sensitivity_discrepancies.rationale: A prespecified wider target-relative sensitivity used to determine whether the promising region is merely sparsely sampled; diagnostic only.

scored_years_rationale: Uses the identical nineteen prespecified Tier-1 trajectory anchors as the parent learning wave.

waves.comment: Focused wave drawn from the verified parent primary NROY geometry; 10% and 20% target-relative alternatives are scored on the same simulations.

run_settings.note: Uses the same three CRN seeds and A-5 V_ensemble scaling as the parent, so differences reflect the focused parameter design rather than a changed stochastic estimator.
